narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -2.12 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.2560-0.2607 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.2724; the first objective pays 1.54R at 0.2521.
